identity.name: RACCOON APP
identity.mission: The nocturnal playground for real-time connection. Fast, mischievous, and addictive.

headings.usage: Use for all section titles, hero text, and modal headers. Bold and tight.

body.usage: Use for chat messages, UI labels, and long text. clean and legible at small sizes.

monospace.usage: Use for stats, timers, and code snippets.

glassmorphism.heavy: backdrop-filter: blur(16px); background: rgba(10, 10, 10, 0.8); border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
glassmorphism.light: backdrop-filter: blur(8px); background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05); border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);

landing_page.structure: Hero centered with massive typography. Background video or abstract 3D mesh. 'Start Matching' button pulsing.
landing_page.grid: Single column vertical scroll. Section overlap.

dashboard.structure: Bento Grid. High density. 'Live Now' stats prominent. Game modes as large cards.

match_interface.structure: Immersive Split Screen. User video (bottom right floating) + Stranger video (full screen or split). Chat overlay on left.
match_interface.controls: Floating pill bar at bottom (Skip, Next, Report).

chat_screen.structure: Sidebar (matches) + Main Chat Area + Game Panel (Right sidebar or Overlay).

instructions_to_main_agent: INSTALL FONTS: Ensure Outfit and Manrope are imported from Google Fonts in index.html.
TAILWIND CONFIG: Update tailwind.config.js to include the custom colors (primary: #7c3aed, background: #0a0a0a) and extend the theme.
GLASSMORPHISM: Create a reusable utility class or component for the 'Glass Card' effect.
GAME OVERLAYS: Implement games (Feud, Truth/Dare) as Modal/Overlay components that sit ON TOP of the video chat, with transparency so users can still see each other.
MATCHING LOGIC: Visual feedback is key. Use a scanning/radar animation while searching for a match.
MOBILE FIRST: Ensure the video chat controls are thumb-accessible at the bottom of the screen on mobile.
DATA-TESTID: Add data-testid to all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, cards) for testing.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur)
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯📚🎭🎬🎪🎉🎊🎁🎀🎂🍰🎈🎨🎰💰💵💳🏦💎🪙💸🤑📊📈📉💹🔢🏆🥇 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable
Create new components that match the style and conventions of existing components when needed
Examine existing components to understand the project's component patterns before creating new ones
Components MUST use named exports (export const ComponentName = ...)
Pages MUST use default exports (export default function PageName() {...})
Use sonner for toasts. Sonner component are located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.tsx
